# プロンプト出力例

以下は付属の出力エンジンで生成した例です。

## 温室で振り返る人物・汎用英語タグ

~~~text
young man, silver hair, short layered hair, teal eyes, black tailored jacket, gentle smile, looking at viewer, standing, looking back over shoulder, upper body shot, eye-level angle, rear three-quarter view, third-person perspective, centered composition, glass conservatory, dappled sunlight, midday, otome game event CG
~~~

## 同じ人物が手を差し伸べる・PixAI Tsubaki系

~~~text
The subject is a young man. The character has silver hair. The hairstyle features short layered hair. The character has teal eyes.

The character wears a black tailored jacket.

Frame the scene as a waist-up shot. View the scene from a low angle. The camera views the subject at a three-quarter angle. The viewpoint belongs to the protagonist. Place the subject behind a large foreground object.

The character stands still. The character reaches one hand toward the viewer.

The face shows a gentle smile. The gaze is directed toward the viewer.

The setting is a flower garden. The scene is lit by warm rim lighting. The time is dusk.

Render the scene as an otome game event illustration.
~~~

## 同じ場面・NovelAI向け

~~~text
1boy, young man, silver hair, short layered hair, teal eyes, black tailored jacket, standing, outstretched hand toward viewer, gentle smile, looking at viewer, flower garden, warm rim lighting, dusk, waist-up shot, low-angle view, three-quarter view, protagonist POV, oversized foreground object, otome game event CG
~~~

## 放課後の教室で戸惑う・英語自然文

~~~text
The subject is a young man. The character has silver hair. The hairstyle features short layered hair. The character has teal eyes. The character wears a black tailored jacket. The face shows a puzzled look. The gaze is directed toward the viewer. The character stands still. The character reaches one hand toward the viewer. Frame the scene as an upper-body portrait. The setting is an empty Japanese classroom after school. Render the scene as an otome game event illustration.
~~~

## 既存LoRAを使い、背景と画風を除外・PixAI SDXL系

~~~text
adult traveler, auburn hair, <lora:my_traveler:0.8>, tearful smile, looking away
~~~

## 組み合わせの確認

この撮影距離では足元が画面外になります。膝上や全身の構図も検討できます。
